'''Traveling and the Territories''' is one of the magic systems of the Willverse.

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Travelers]] are terrifying entities that possess a thousand powers, many of which are gruesome. These beings utilize Territories, which are powers summoned from elsewhere by a [[Traveler]]. A [[Territory]] can be accessed through a Gate and is capable of answering mental calls. Specific types of [[Travelers]] exist, such as [[Endross Travelers]] who can control an [[Endross Gate]]—a rift between worlds that grows in power the longer it stays open. If such a gate escapes a [[Traveler]]'s control, it can explode or unleash uncontrolled power. Other notable types include [[Ornheim Travelers]], who can summon [[stone]] from their [[Territory]] to create golems using carved rubies, and [[Valinhall Travelers]]. Unlike others, [[Valinhall Travelers]] summon power into themselves rather than from the outside, making them excellent in combat against other Territories. [[Valinhall]] itself is a unique [[Territory]] that functions as a house containing an entire world where time moves slower than the outside world and [[inhabitants]] are tested through attacks. [[Travelers]] can also be associated with specific locations or titles, such as those of Ragnarus or [[Ornheim]].}}
